text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a sec...
What is this atmosphere...?"

Entering the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies in high spirits.
The atmosphere in the paddock was completely different from before.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The lineup is... entirely different. Every last one of them
has a build that looks like it's packed with springiness...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And what is with this massive crowd!?
The entire venue is packed to the brim...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So this is a GⅠ... This is the Hanshin JF...
Kuh...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah......
I'd like to say I'm fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've ended up in totally the wrong place...
Did I really mess up?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... none of them have any give. Unlike me,
they're not trying to just brute-force things on momentum alone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Can I really stand a chance against this...?
choice_data_list: Vodka, don't let it swallow you up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I know, Trainer. But damn,
I'm gettin' massive bad vibes from this...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even if I go all out, it might not be enough.
If things go wrong, I'll make a total fool of myself...!
choice_data_list: If you give it your all, there's nothing uncool about it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...?
You say 'if I give it my all', but...
choice_data_list: Even if we can't win, let's go out in a blaze of glory.
Even if we can't win, let's go out in a blaze of glory, okay?

text_block_list.text:
When I told her that true cool is standing tall
even when the odds are against you...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Not flinching... that's what's cool...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you said it.
That's my partner for ya."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Chickening out without even trying
is the most uncool thing ever. So――

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll just give it everything and go for broke!
That's the coolest thing I can possibly do right now!

Vodka grits her teeth and nods.
Her usual fierce determination finally returns to her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right, just you watch.
You top-tier geniuses...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I won't let anyone beat me at living life to the fullest.
I'll burn my coolness into all your eyes!
